preview: Today’s story takes us to the Strait of Hormuz. It brings together political claims and the movement of commercial ships. It can be difficult to see how these two parts connect. This matters because the strait is an important route for global energy. As you listen, ask what words and agreements can actually change there.
comment_1: Listen for what President Trump says about the Strait of Hormuz and how Iran responds.
comment_2: We just heard President Trump claim US control of the strait, while Iran rejected that claim. Now, does a separate agreement between Iran and Oman mean normal shipping can return?
comment_3: This story shows a clear difference between political claims and practical talks about shipping. Next, we will look at what control can mean and why the route map matters beyond the strait.
comment_4: Keep these two ideas in mind. Control can mean different things, and even a technical shipping map can matter worldwide. Now let us bring the story together in one line.
